hints.title: First Non-A Character
hints.text: To make the string lexicographically smaller, shift the first non-a character backward.

hints.title: Avoid Shifting A
hints.text: Shifting 'a' produces 'z', which worsens the string lexicographically, so avoid shifting 'a' unless required.

hints.title: Contiguous Non-A Segment
hints.text: Shift every character from the first non-a up to the next 'a' or string end; if all are 'a', change only the last character to 'z'.

hints.title: Greedy Shift Traversal

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all O(n^2) substrings takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Character array allows mutable in-place shifting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that leading 'a's must not be shifted and handles the all-'a' corner case.
